title: DecisionEpisode
description: The full supervised record of one decision (HAR-97 §8, HAR-129 §14): state the agent saw, what it proposed, every eval, what the human did, and — later — how the customer and the business responded. The human decision is high-value supervision, not truth. Since HAR-129 an episode is opened when the strategy set is generated and closes in stages (status); episodes recorded before that (and runs without a strategy set) are simply 'decided'. The HAR-129 objects hang off the episode by decision_episode_id (strategy set, human strategy decision, judgment inference) and are not repeated here; state before/after is the state diff's from/to version; candidate knowledge and evaluator versions are found through knowledge_evidence and the human delta.

status.description: awaiting_choice: strategy set shown, nothing chosen. chosen: a strategy was selected, no send decision yet. decided: send or discard recorded (the HumanDecision exists). judged: the judgment inference exists and the human has answered it.

held_out_event_id.description: The replay event that started the episode; absent for live episodes.

eval_result_ids.description: Every EvalResult of the run, for all candidates when there is a strategy set.

learning_scope.description: Whether the human's correction looks account-specific or like a candidate reusable criterion (HAR-129 §12, step 30). Only a verdict on the scope; promotion still needs scoping and backtesting.

state_transition.description: The StateTransition the agent read at the replay clock (HAR-128; the full object, never rewritten by the agent): the open CANDIDATE/UNRESOLVED transition, else the newest CONFIRMED one. Null when the account had none.

supporting_evidence.description: Evidence behind the transition's satisfied facts, one entry per fact.

missing_evidence.description: The transition's unmet facts (the 'what remains unknown' list).

allOf.description: Once the human has decided, the decision and the final draft exist.
Before the human decides there is no decision, action or final draft.
A replay episode points at the change it reacts to.
Edits and manual replacements carry the human's final artifact and a delta.
